preregistration.intent: Intent screen only. Measures whether provided Overture sources[].update_time / sources[].version metadata is usable as a source-update recency (data-vintage) signal, and whether a small fixed stale / metadata-gap uncertainty term adds information beyond the frozen source-mixture proportions. No target, no label, no leaderboard value, no accuracy claim, no upload.
preregistration.reference_epoch_policy: The reference epoch is the maximum explicitly-UTC parseable update_time over the source entries of features assigned to the official scored GEOIDs of the four regions and three themes. It is derived from the provided metadata itself: no external clock, no wall-clock read and no external timestamp source enters the computation, so repeated runs are deterministic.

feature_schema.note: sources is a list of structs; only dataset, update_time and version are read from it.

reference_epoch.policy: The reference epoch is the maximum explicitly-UTC parseable update_time over the source entries of features assigned to the official scored GEOIDs of the four regions and three themes. It is derived from the provided metadata itself: no external clock, no wall-clock read and no external timestamp source enters the computation, so repeated runs are deterministic.

closed_set_accounting.unit_definition: one per assigned source entry plus one per assigned feature whose sources list is null or empty

beyond_source_mixture.definition: Ordinary least squares of the tract adjustment on the frozen source-mixture share columns (intercept included), restricted to tracts where the adjustment is defined, plus the same regression with per-theme log1p feature counts added and a counts-only control. Report R-squared, residual standard deviation, residual-to-total standard deviation ratio, and the largest absolute Pearson correlation with any single mixture share.

naive_as_utc.note: naive timestamps are counted in the status shares but never used as instants

version_date_fallback.note: sources[].version coverage and status shares are reported per theme and region; the calendar-date fallback is never used in the primary adjustment

sensitivity.adoption: Every sensitivity variant is diagnostic only and carries adopted=false. No cutoff, weight, status policy or bound is changed as a result of this screen.

reproducibility.command: COMPETITION_WORKSPACE="$COMPETITION_WORKSPACE" uv run --with numpy==2.5.4 --with pyarrow==26.0.0 --with pyproj==3.8.0 --with shapely==2.2.0 python scripts/build_source_freshness_candidate.py
reproducibility.timings: wall-clock timings are printed to stdout and deliberately not embedded so that repeated runs are byte-identical

method.population: official scored GEOIDs only, authoritative sample order
method.assignment: One contribution per Overture building/segment/POI row, assigned to at most one tract by bbox centre with the frozen assign_points rule (within first, then intersects; ties resolved by lowest tract index).
method.naive_policy: Counted and reported separately. Never assumed to be UTC and never used in the primary age distribution or the primary adjustment, because a wall-clock string without a designator cannot be placed on the UTC timeline without an assumption the provided metadata does not state.
method.version_fallback_policy: sources[].version is frequently a bare calendar date. It is reported as its own coverage statistic and described as a fallback (read as UTC midnight of that calendar date), but it is never used in the primary age distribution or the primary adjustment.
method.theme_aggregation: Over themes present in the tract (at least one assigned feature) renormalise the frozen theme weights and take the weighted mean of the per-theme theme_uncertainty.
method.stale_share_definition: Among the tract-theme source entries with an explicitly-UTC parseable update_time, the share whose age in days exceeds stale_cutoff_days.
method.metadata_gap_share_definition: Among all assigned tract-theme source entries, the share whose update_time status is not in primary_age_statuses (naive, null, empty or malformed).
method.undefined_rule: A tract with no assigned feature in any theme is undefined and receives the deterministic placeholder stated by undefined_placeholder; undefined tracts are counted and never imputed from region means.
method.quantile_definition: nearest rank on the per-tract sorted instant list with rank = max(1, ceil(percentile / 100 * n)); pooled entry quantiles use the equivalent reversed instant quantiles
method.beyond_mixture_method: Ordinary least squares of the tract adjustment on the frozen source-mixture share columns (intercept included), restricted to tracts where the adjustment is defined, plus the same regression with per-theme log1p feature counts added and a counts-only control. Report R-squared, residual standard deviation, residual-to-total standard deviation ratio, and the largest absolute Pearson correlation with any single mixture share.
